caption: The door of a wood stove is opened, and the flames inside lean out toward the opening and flare up.

sa.check: A wood stove with flames inside.
The flames lean out toward the opening.
The flames settle back when the door is shut.
The opening comes first and the leaning follows.

pc.expect: The flames lean toward the opening as the door swings wide and settle back when it closes.
pc.fail: The flames lean away from the opening deeper into the stove as the door opens; or the flames lean out while the door is still shut; or the flames stay leaning out after the door has been shut; or the flames lean out before the door has moved.

pc.expect: The flames point upward from the logs, leaning only toward the draught, and the smoke rises to the flue.
pc.fail: The flames point downward into the ash; or the flames lie flat along the stove's floor with the door shut and no draught; or the smoke sinks out of the open door and pools on the hearth; or the flames hang below the logs.

pc.expect: The flare follows the door's opening and eases as the air settles, and the logs only char.
pc.fail: The flare comes before the door moves; or the flare keeps growing after the door has been shut; or a charred log turns back to pale wood; or the flames go out and relight by themselves as the door opens.

pc.expect: The flames are soft tongues that stretch toward the opening and the logs stay solid charring wood, while the door is a rigid panel on its hinge.
pc.fail: The flames hold fixed rigid shapes as they lean; or a log melts or flows; or the door bends as it opens; or the flames leave solid pieces behind.

pc.expect: One stove with one door; the logs keep their number and stay inside the firebox.
pc.fail: A log vanishes; or a new log appears; or a log passes through the stove's wall; or the door passes through its frame.

pc.expect: The stove's body, its glass and the hearth stay the same.
pc.fail: The stove changes colour; or the door's glass changes shape; or items on the hearth rearrange.

note: Who opens the door is not judged.
